description: An autosave copy of a build of the earlier specification: the audio of all the copies is in the shared Project_Media folder, which mediaFolder names; the summary says that every copy shares it and that this server does not delete it.

result.summary: opentune_save_project: wrote autosave copy 3 (path in autosave.path); the project file was not changed; the project has no unsaved changes. Not stored in the copy: the undo and redo history, global preferences. OpenTune also copies the audio the project uses into the Project_Media folder inside the autosave folder (mediaFolder); every copy shares that folder, a file of the same name in it is replaced, and this server does not delete it when it rolls a copy away.
